Name: Cold Weather
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
I was testing the new trigger actions when I had this small idea.

Cold weather triggers a cold debuff when the player is outdoors that can be cancelled when they eat or drink warm food or get indoors!

Food list:
[spoiler]
Parsnip Soup
Tom Kha Soup
Trout Soup
Pumpkin Soup
Algae Soup
Moss Soup
Coffee
Triple Shot Espresso
Green Tea
Chowder
Dish O' The Sea
[/spoiler]
